listing.name: Super Mario Odyssey (smo-recomp)
listing.summary: Experimental AArch64 to C game DLL plus own Windows native runtime/Vulkan; no interpreter/JIT or running firmware claimed. Upstream maturity: Early; scripted Cap Kingdom and short stage stress, manual Cap to Cascade checkpoint. Some observations from1.0.0 predate1.4.1; update additions untested; no online. Acquisition: No releases; local setup with LLVM9/VS2019 SDK/VulkanSDK/SDL3/Python lifts/compiles from owned dump. Platforms: Windows10/11 x64 Vulkan1.3; developed RTX4090; listed required Vulkan extensions. No other desktop offer. Original data: Own decrypted SMO1.4.1 updated program, merged RomFS and update control data. Keys/firmware explicitly unnecessary for this extracted route. Exact region/build fingerprints not exposed. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
